name: The White House
description: The White House, literally translated as the white house, is the official residence and office of the President of the United States. The foundation site of the White House was selected by George Washington, the founding father and first president of the United States. Construction began in 1792 and was basically completed in 1800. The designer was the famous Irish-American architect James Hoban. But it was not called the White House at the time. The White House was officially named by President Theodore Roosevelt in 1902.
